title: Causal structure is no third option between process and state

statements.text: A causal structure that consists in an actually occurring sequence, such as broadcasting, recurrent propagation or feedback, depends on $X_{<t}$ and falls under the theorem. A structure derived from the present state is state-based only if the mapping from $X_t$ to the structure is unique and physically grounded. Otherwise the attribution depends on the analysis.

sources.quote: Causal structure therefore provides no third alternative between process and state.
The tension between actual activity and counterfactual structure as bases for computational consciousness attribution was identified by Maudlin (1989).
